answer: Each identity has one TPM chip as its anchor; the tenth in a chip lot posts a $2,000 bond. Registration binds the chip's endorsement key, locks a bond of $200 times its place in the lot, and full weight waits behind a 30-day horizon at 10%. Five falcon auditors spot-check 5% of chips each epoch for a fresh signed quote within 24 hours. One failed quote burns the lot's bonds and kills its identities. 100 clones across 10 lots cost $114,500; 100 honest agents pay $24,500, one pays $245. A wall of safes works the same way. Each extra drawer costs more, and a falcon watches the corridor.
